scope: Read-only actual Settings diagnostic on previously shut-down iPhone 18 Pro, iOS 27.0 (24A434). No new system-selected widget privacy acceptance.
reason: A newly available runtime is a distinct environment from the previous iOS 26.5 diagnostic.
consoleWarning: UIAccessibilityLoaderWebShared exists in both system WebKit.axbundle and WebCore.axbundle; retained, not a warning-free runtime claim.

rootButtonLabels: Apple Account, Sign in to access your iCloud data, the App Store, Apple services and more.

finding: Actual Passcode row opens a visually blank page containing only the Settings back button, with no static text or switches. canEvaluatePolicy true is not evidence of usable privacy controls.
next: Do not repeat the same search/page test on either recorded runtime. Genuine host-selected privacy still requires an environment with supported controls and a verifiable locked/unlocked transition. Other remaining system-widget interactions and user-deferred speech/signing retain their existing boundaries.
